content: SnapTrade (brokerage-aggregator, closest analog to a multi-broker journal) fires a webhook when a connection becomes 'disabled' (broken handshake, changed broker password, revoked grant, or expired session requiring re-auth). App is expected to listen for this webhook and prompt the user to reconnect by re-running the same connect flow with a 'reconnect' parameter pointing at the existing connection's UUID, rather than creating a duplicate connection. A second webhook fires when the connection is fixed. Source: docs.snaptrade.com (primary vendor docs, MEDIUM).
